items.title: Unpack, edit XML, repack
items.description: Edits happen at the OpenXML level, so styles, headers and footers, sections, numbering, tracked changes and images survive untouched.

items.title: Chinese official layout
items.description: First-class support for CJK documents and the GB/T 9704 official document layout.

items.title: Templates and placeholders
items.description: Fills placeholders in bulk, which suits contracts, reports and other repetitive documents.

items.title: Render and validate
items.description: Ships validation and rendering scripts so layout regressions are caught before delivery.

items.title: Unpack
items.description: Expand the .docx into its OpenXML parts.

items.title: Edit in place
items.description: Change only the nodes that need to change instead of rebuilding the document.

items.title: Repack and validate
items.description: Repack, then run validation and a rendering check.

blocks.title: Runtime requirements
blocks.content: Requires a local Python 3 toolchain (lxml, python-docx). Format conversion and rendering checks additionally require LibreOffice.

## When to use

Creating, editing, filling, reformatting and converting Word documents: contracts, reports, proposals, official documents, theses, mail merges and template filling.
